title: Chunktils
description: Chunktils is a utility-focused Minecraft mod built to make large-scale chunk clearing faster, smarter, and more controlled.
body:
# **Chunktils**
Chunktils gives players a powerful, survival-friendly way to clear chunks using upgradeable machines called Chunk Eaters. Instead of instantly deleting land, Chunk Eaters mine through the chunk over time, collect blocks into nearby storage, respect filters, and avoid protected blocks like bedrock and spawners.

Whether you are preparing land for a mega base, clearing underground space, or automating excavation on a server, Chunktils makes chunk clearing cleaner, smarter, and more controlled.

**Content**

**Eater Core**
![Core](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4276dd8c6450d5db1268f426e3cbd0ff107980ce.jpeg)
The Eater Core is the main crafting component used to create every Chunk Eater tier.

It is required for:
- Chunk Eater Mk I
- Chunk Eater Mk II
- Chunk Eater Mk III

**Chunk Eater Mk I**
![Tier 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de0736a7d6f27bb1071c8baa690f7774ba261da5.jpeg)
The first basic Chunk Eater tier.

**Features:**
- Clears 1 chunk over time
- Uses nearby storage
- Protects bedrock and spawners
- Supports basic chunk excavation

**Chunk Eater Mk II**
![Tier 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03426c0725801634d78206f3dd5969705aaa6860.jpeg)
An upgraded Chunk Eater with better progression and stronger crafting requirements.

**Features:**
- Clears a 3x3 chunk over time
- Requires the previous tier to craft
- Built for larger survival projects
- Keeps the same safety protections

**Chunk Eater Mk III**
![Tier 3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78b31abaa05af6794282eb16f697008e2c9c19b1.jpeg)
The strongest current Chunk Eater tier.

**Features:**
- Clears 5x5 chunk over time
- Highest tier Chunk Eater
- Requires Mk II to craft
- Great for mega bases and large terrain clearing

****Chunktils Recipe Book
![Recipe Book](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3fb053b416b63447858636194c42f3d580ab384c.jpeg)
**The Chunktils Recipe Book** 

lets players view the mod’s recipes in game, making it easier to understand progression without needing to leave Minecraft.

**Main Features**
- Progress-based chunk clearing
- Custom Chunk Eater GUI
- Upgradeable machine tiers
- Storage detection before mining
- Block and item filtering
- Liquid sealing support
- Converts mined stone into cobblestone
- Adds mined blocks to player statistics
- Does not mine bedrock
- Does not mine spawners
- Survival-friendly progression
- Works great for servers and mega builds

**Step-by-step Guide**
**Using a Chunk Eater**
1. Craft an Eater Core.
2. Craft a Chunk Eater Mk I.
3. Place the Chunk Eater inside the chunk you want to clear.
4. Place storage nearby.
5. Open the Chunk Eater GUI.
6. Configure filters if needed.
7. Press Run to begin clearing.
8. Upgrade to higher tiers for stronger machines.
 
**FAQ**
**Why is my Chunk Eater not starting?**

Make sure nearby storage has enough space for the mined blocks. The Chunk Eater checks storage before clearing.

**Does it delete items?**

No. Chunktils is designed to store mined blocks instead of simply deleting them.

**Does it mine spawners?**

No. Spawners are protected and will not be mined.

**Does it mine bedrock?**

No. Bedrock is protected.

**Can I use this on a server?**

Yes. Chunktils is designed to be useful for survival servers, technical players, and large community projects.

**Are more features planned?**

Yes. More tools, upgrades, automation options, and improvements may be added in future updates.

Recommended For
- Mega base builders
- Survival players
- Technical Minecraft players
- Server owners
- Automation-focused gameplay
- Large excavation projects
